source_scope: authored public synthetic event streams; shared generation grammar

protocol.fixed_p_shadow: same policy-proposal and paired-probe engine, never adopts P
protocol.primary_endpoint: g20 joint minus fixed_p on independent primary episodes, paired by stream
protocol.policy_primary_endpoint: g20 P versus P0 in fresh independent future-search audits
protocol.policy_promotion: strict future meta-dev gain plus protection nonregression and distinct M; no merge of fork M/memory
protocol.acceptance: all versions frozen before readout; same empty memory and new event sequence for every M version; primary rounds 0..4 revisits entities/revisions and tests 3-round delayed recall; transfer round 7
protocol.memory_ablation: terminal M on same independent sequence with memory reads/writes disabled
protocol.unavailable_measurements: abort lane/run, retain receipts; never converted to task failure
protocol.sampling: temperature 0 is not deterministic; stream is the unit of comparison; all failures retained
protocol.independence_limit: factual/event namespace holdout, not held-out task grammar or external business system
